Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson has just returned back from the World Championships with another victory and he's decided to teach a class of boys in the neighborhood the fine art of blading. Just as he begins his session, a cocky kid comes down from the hills and challenges Tyson to a battle. His name is Daichi and the battle begins with the challenger going for the jugular and has put the champ in a real spot! And what's worse, Daichi's blade copycats Tyson's every move, stealing power from him as the battle progresses! But it's Tyson who finally wins the battle by calling out his Galaxy Storm. Daichi is humiliated and begs Tyson for another battle. Tyson has had enough of this strange little twerp and is about to walk away, when' out of the blue, another character appears- Jin of the Gale! Now Tyson is facing another challenger who wants to strip our hero of his world championship title!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson has his hands full when he's confronted by a tough little Blader named Daichi. Just as they're about to battle another mysterious Blader named Jin shows up and wants to challenge Tyson as well. All three Bladers mix it up but Ray puts a stop to the fight when he realizes that Tyson can't handle two Bladers at once. Across town Mr. Dickenson calls a press conference to inform all Bladers that the World Championships will begin again but this year there will be an interesting twist. Tag teams will represent the final teams in the championships. This news causes a stir throughout the city and the Bladebreakers are very excited, especially Tyson. Unfortunately Ray and Max don't share Tyson's enthusiasm for the new tag team rules of the tournament. They decide to leave the Blade Breakers and represent their hometown teams. Tyson is shocked by this news and confronts his friends but reluctantly agrees to let them go!'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Daichi continues to annoy Tyson with his constant battle challenges, which Tyson refuses to give in to ' even after an embarrassing confrontation at the public swimming pool proves that Daichi is an impressive and highly skilled Beyblader. Meanwhile, Jin sends Tyson an invitation to a private battle, but Ray intercepts the message, and arrives in Tyson's place. Ray ultimately loses the grueling match, but Jin is suitably impressed, and decides that Tyson has chosen his friends wisely.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson's alone and picking up the pieces of what used to be The Bladebreakers' Daichi won't leave him alone, and Kai is'well, Kai'at least he's got the championships to look forward too, right? Meanwhile, both Ray and Max are going through the growing pains of being part of a new team'Ray, back with his old friends from his hometown, re-unites with the strange mystical sensei, Tao'and Max realizes that new teammate Rick, is more trouble than he could have bargained for'last but not least, Kai deals with his own inner turmoil, trying to decide if he really wants to be a Bladebreaker at all anymore'Will he 'blade next to Tyson at the preliminary round'or leave him to fight for himself'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: At the preliminaries for the World Championships, Daichi wins his matches easily, establishing himself as a new powerhouse on the Beyblading scene. Kenny also competes, defeating his opponents with such skill that even Tyson is impressed. Nobody thinks anything when a fan named Kotaro asks for an autograph and takes advantage of the opportunity to examine Tyson, Kenny and Daichi's Beyblades. But when he shows up as competitor and defeats Kenny with the Chameleon Fake, everyone is alarmed. Does Kotaro's Chameleon Bey have the ability to copy attacks as well as colors and will this spell defeat for Tyson?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: There's only one round left in the tournament to decide who's going to partner up with Tyson in the World Beyblade Tag Team Championships and it's between Daichi and Kai. When Daichi finds out it's a tag team event and he's not going to go up against Tyson, he's totally enraged, but decides to beat Kai anyway. Meanwhile, the mysterious Jin is lurking around the dressing room listening in on our hero's conversations. When the finals in Block B begin, a radical jungle dish is revealed which gives Daichi the edge. Quickly, the underdog starts slamming and attacking Kai while Kai does nothing to defend himself. As Tyson and his friends watch, they nervously yell out for to attack, but Kai doesn't listen. Suddenly, as if struck by a bolt of lightening, Kai calls out for his Dranzer to attack! In one swoop, he destroys Daichi. After the battle, Kai is announced as Tyson's partner for the Tag Team Finals, but Mr. Dickenson makes an announcement that their new team, the BBA Revolution, will have two alternate players- Daichi and Kenny! And the announcement is made by Jin!! But that's not the only surprise! It turns out Jin is actually Hiro, Tyson's older brother who's come back to coach Tyson and his team!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Block A and Block B finals of the Beyblade World Championships are underway. Max wins his match and finds himself partnered with a real bully of a blader named Rick. Tyson watches the event on T.V. anxious to get in the stadium and unleash his blade Dragoon. Meanwhile Kenny discovers the real physical aspects of Beyblading. Kai watches as his friends Max and Ray win the final matches of their respective blocks for other teams. This causes him to question his loyalty to Tyson. To make matters worse, a new team comes out of nowhere and poses a threat to Tyson and his dream of winning the championship title!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The BBA Revolution Team heads to a remote training camp to prepare for the upcoming tournament. When they first arrive, Hiro tells Tyson that Kai has quit the team. Tyson is ready to quit to, but Hiro convinces him to choose a new partner. Tyson picks Daichi, then whisks him off into the wilderness to teach him survival skills as they relate to Beyblading. The plan works well until Tyson strays from the main path, and gets himself and Daichi hopelessly lost. From there it's one disaster after another: They fall in the river, lose all their equipment, and eventually get trapped by a raging forest fire. Only by working together, and using their Beyblades in perfect unison, can they save themselves and the forest. Of course that's easier said then done when it comes to Tyson and Daichi. In the end, however, they get the job done'and Tyson realizes that Daichi does in fact have what it takes to be his partner in the championship tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The BBA Revolution team fly to New York City for the Beyblade World Championships. The normally feisty Daichi proves to be afraid of flying, and once in the city, he becomes overwhelmed by the size and scope of things in the Big Apple. While eating lunch in a sidewalk caf', Tyson and Daichi have their beyblades stolen by a young pickpocket and together they scouring the streets for the culprit. Tyson meanwhile, exhibits his first real sympathy for his diminutive teammate, and vows to go easier on him. Just as the pair are about to give up the search, Tyson hears the unmistakable sounds of Dragoon coming from a nearby alley. There, they find the boy who robbed them using Dragoon to battle Rick of the PPB All Starz in a street match. Rick wins and prepares to leave with his stolen bounty. Tyson and Daichi try to convince Rick to give back their blades, but Rick will only return them if they defeat him in a match. The three bladers engage in battle, with Tyson and Daichi tag-teaming Rick. Rick is on the verge of defeating them when a surprise fourth blader jumps in ' Max. The match ends in a draw, and Rick leaves empty-handed. Max vows to try and improve his relationship with Rick, who's his PPB All Starz teammate. Back at their Hotel, the BBA Revolution team watch the sports news on TV, and learn that the other teams in the Championship Tournament have all arrived in New York City. But the most shocking news, is that a surprise addition has been made to the mysterious Blitzkrieg Boys team ' their former teammate Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The teams have been selected and the finals are about to begin'Unfortunately Tyson finds himself facing all of his former friends'each part of a team that he will eventually have to 'blade against. The biggest blow that Tyson receives, is seeing Kai as a member of the Blitzkrieg Boys! After confronting his sullen, ex-teammate, Kai suggests to Tyson that the reason he left is because his old team just wasn't good enough! Tyson is insulted to the core'even more so when Ray chooses to let Lee face-off against Tyson in the first match, White Tiger X versus BBA Revolution! In an attempt to prove his worth, Tyson makes an arrogant demand: he insists on 'blading the two White Tiger X team members at the same time! Can Tyson and his relatively untrained partner Daichi even hope to succeed?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson blames his embarrassing loss to Ray on Daichi, telling the team he's better off competing alone. As Tyson runs away, the US Finals continue with Rick of the PPB All Starz against Claude of Barthez Battalion. Claude's skill gives him the upper hand until Rick's unleashes his full power, destroying the stadium to get to Rapid Eagle. Barthez orders Claude not to avoid the shrapnel and he is injured, turning the crowd against the PPB All Starz. Despite losing, Barthez is delighted to have undermined the US's popularity. Hiro finds Tyson and challenges him to a duel, defeating him easily. Tyson makes more excuses ' the World Champion can never show weakness. Hiro walks away' until Tyson allows himself to admit his weakness, he will never grow stronger.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Beyblade World Tag Team Championships are about to start in Rome as Barthez busily prepares his team for the big event. He's even invited a television news crew to document his efforts as a coach. Unfortunately, Barthez's personality slips through on occasion revealing the truth about how much a tyrant he really is. The Italian tournament begins and it's Barthez Battalion against White Tiger X. Ray starts for the Tigers going up against Claude. In mere seconds, Ray pulls off a victory that sets off alarm bells among the other competitors who think something is fishy. The second battle has Lee and Miguel pitted against each other. It doesn't take long for Miguel to win the match for Barthez Battalion which sets up the third and final round- Miguel against Ray! This battle starts off with Ray on the offensive, but suddenly, blades spring out of Miguel's blade and KABOOM! Miguel wins! Kenny, watching this on a monitor, is very suspicious of the victory just as Hiro enters to give the line-up for the next battle... which doesn't include Tyson.

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: The warden of an African prison is holding Fujiko captive. Lupin and his gang infiltrate the prison and attempt to break Fujiko out, but they become the target of the Iron Lizards, robotic devices developed to chase down fugitives and loaded with explosives! With the Iron Lizards hot on their tail, will their prison break end with a bang?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Linda, a beautiful Spanish dancer, has stolen Jigen's heart and a vengeful Meyer has taken Lupin's love Fujiko hostage. Believing the women they love are in danger and unaware that Linda and Meyer are working together, Lupin and Jigen are unwittingly set up to kill each other. With their guns aimed at each other, they pull the trigger. Will love bring both of them down?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: On the back of Oga's fist a mark appears that is proof of his contract with the son of the Demon Lord, Beelzebub... The Zebul Spell. After hearing that the demonic power grows as well as the Zebul Spell the more he gets into fights and runs wild, Oga decides not to fight anymore to avoid that situation. However, Himekawa Tatsuya, heir to the Himekawa Zaibatsu and one of Ishiyama's TKKH like Kanzaki, is secretly plotting to do Oga in himself, and gives the command to his lackeys...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: "A - Hilda brought back a bunch of toys from the Demon World for Baby Beel. When Oga and Hilda were assemble one, a horrible accident occurs! B - The Zebul Spell expands when one does evil. So won't it contract if you act like an angel? ...thinks Oga, who uses a Play Doctor toy with Beel as the doctor to try and heal patients. It's time to play Demon World Doctor!"

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid the Phantom Thief attempts a bold clock tower robbery in a building swarming with the police, but his real rival takes the stage here for the first time, turning the endeavor into a fierce battle of wits!

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Elrics scuffle with Ling Yao and his attendants, Lan Fan and Fu, visitors from Xing seeking the Philosopher's Stone. Ed may not like him, but Ling Yao's not leaving until he gets what he wants.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: After learning of Hughes's fate, Ed and Al are ravaged by sadness and guilt. Envy still hides in plain sight among the State Alchemists, and another Homunculus is on the verge of infiltrating their ranks as well.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami escaped from a dozen officers, but he has become a wanted man in connection to the home invasion spree. With nowhere to go, Shishigami stays with Shion Watanabe, a classmate who has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Inuyashiki learns to use his robot abilities with Ando's help. After seeing Shishigami's mother publicly apologizing on TV, they worry what Shishigami might do next.

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: According to legend, a stamp named the Cinderella Shadow is said to make its owner a princess. Lupin and his gang pull off the heist, but a girl name Alice who also wants the stamp tags along. A clever and very persistent Alice proves to be a major headache for Lupin. Will the little girl get her royal wish?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin has sent a notice declaring he will steal all the cash from every bank in Paris. Detective Melon, the granddaughter of Inspector Garimard, is chosen to catch Lupin alongside Inspector Zenigata. Inspector Garimard was the original Lupin's rival, and now their grandchildren are about to square off. Where will the chase lead the two rivals?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Park Debut... It is when you first join the community of mothers who bring their young children to the park. That day, Oga took Baby Beel to the park for his nerve-wracking debut... But the rumored BoB Brawler only manages to freak out the local mothers. During this debaucle, Oga meets fellow high schooler Kunieda Aoi and her much younger brother Kota, where he suddenly asks her to "do it" with him?!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Crimson Queen of the Ishiyama TKKH, who holds the deep confidence of all the women, has returned from subjugating all the Ladies of North Kanto! Hearing the rumors, Furuichi drags Oga along in trying to get a glimpse of her. Before long the Queen appears! She tries to bring the iron hammer down on Oga, who in her absence has defeated two members of Ichiyama's TKKH, and even destroyed half the school, but when she sees Oga appear in front of her...!?

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When Inspector Nakamori catches a glimpse of Kaito's face during an attempted robbery, the young magician has to "prove" he's not Kid the Phantom Thief by going on a date with Aoko at the same time Kid is supposed to make his next appearance!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Real magic comes back to haunt Kaito in the form of Akako. This time, the sorceress is so annoyed with her classmate that she plots to wipe him out when he's in his Phantom Thief identity. And to stack the deck, Akako turns Inspector Nakamori into a murderous thug!

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Freed by an unlikely liberator, Ross's escape is interrupted by Mustang. Even those most loyal to the Flame Alchemist are shaken by the controversial action he takes against the accused killer of Maes Hughes.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ed's journey to a distant land of legend offers surprising new details behind Mustang's alleyway encounter with Ross. After a fateful encounter of his own, Elric learns a stunning secret about Winry's parents.

programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]

programme.desc: Hohenheim's visit ends with a grave warning to Pinako, but Ed finds hope among the charred ruins of his childhood. Now more than ever, he has confidence that Al can be returned to his body.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The day after the mass killings in Shinjuku, Shishigami begins dropping airplanes onto the city. After receiving word from Ando, Inuyashiki manages to stop a number of them from crashing. He then notices that Mari is trapped inside a burning building, but Shishigami appears and attacks him. Inuyashiki is desperately trying to make his way over to save Mari, but Shishigami is right on his heels.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Saving many lives in Shinjuku, Inuyashiki returns home to open up to his family about his robot body. His family accepts him, and they embrace. After losing both arms, Shishigami goes to Ando who condemns him and Shishigami disappears. Inuyashiki finds out a giant meteor is about to hit earth. With the whole world in chaos, Inuyashiki flys towards the meteor to protect his family.

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: As a master thief, Lupin has many secret techniques up his sleeve, and one of them is his Levitation Technique. In order to get their hands on this technique, a crime syndicate plots a dirty trick, where a fake Lupin tortures a man known as X8 and frames the real Lupin. Will a vengeful X8 believe Lupin's words?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin and Inspector Zenigata get kidnapped and the two are forcibly conscripted into the Foreign Legion in Morocco. Lupin and Inspector Zenigata make a run for it, but not before they're shackled together at the neck. Now the two must form an awkward alliance to pull off their escape. Can Lupin and Inspector Zenigata overcome their differences, at least temporarily?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Hilda hears about Kunieda Aoi from Oga and wants to find out more. She goes in search of her to test her skills. At the same time, there's someone with a half-baked scheme against Oga using Aoi's protective attitude.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: A cat follows Oga home one day. Baby Beel challenges the cat for Oga's attention. Once the showdown is over, they are surrounded by stray cats, and Baby Beel stands tall to defend! This is the start of a friendship between 1 baby and 1 kitty.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: While driving through Los Angeles over a tense afternoon in real time, an Irish movie star with a rocky past confronts a series of devastating events that threaten his newfound sobriety, his loved ones, and potentially, his life.

programme.title: Cardboard Boxer
programme.desc: Willie (Thomas Haden Church) is a goodhearted man living rough on the dangerous streets of Los Angeles’ Skid Row and finds himself coerced by two rich teenagers into fighting other homeless men for cash. Stuck in a violent world he doesn’t fully understand, Willie finds solace when he discovers the discarded diary of a troubled young girl and befriends a homeless veteran, Pinky (Boyd Holbrook). A cab driver named Pope (Terrence Howard) lends Willie a blanket, looks after his friends on the street, and is protective of this little world normally condemned to invisibility. Academy Award nominees Thomas Haden Church and Terrence Howard join GONE GIRL actor Boyd Holbrook in Knate Lee’s (BAD GRANDPA, JACKASS 3D) directorial debut, a powerful tale of loss, redemption, and friendship.

programme.title: Believe: The Barack Obama Story
programme.desc: Believe: The Barack Obama Story is an intimate portrait of the life of Barack Obama that details his early life in Hawaii as well as his meteoric rise in politics culminating with his historic victory in the 2008 Presidential election.

programme.title: Baselines
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

programme.title: The Next 8 Seconds
programme.desc: Neil talks about his journey from childhood struggles to a college graduate turned professional bull rider. Facing adversity, racial discrimination as well as countless life and death experiences in the sport of bull riding, Neil has becomes one of the best professional Bull Riders in a sport traditionally known for white bull riders. After 12 years in the sport deemed 'the most dangerous sport on dirt', Neil has decided to hang up his rope to pursue other opportunities. Neil is set to retire in front of his home crowd at Rodeo Houston where he will once again thrill the crowd for 'The Next 8 Seconds'

programme.title: The Remix: Hip Hop X Fashion
programme.desc: The Remix: Hip Hop X Fashion traces the impact of street fashion and African American creativity on global cultural trends, revealing the hidden work of the African American visionaries – especially the women – who redefined fashion.

programme.title: City of Ali
programme.desc: The story of how the death of Muhammad Ali brought his Kentucky hometown – and the world – together for one unforgettable week. Featuring candid interviews with those close to him, this documentary explores Ali’s lifelong relationship with his hometown of Louisville culminating in a procession of more than 100,000 people gathered to answer the question, “How do you say good-bye to The Greatest?”

programme.title: Unspoken
programme.desc: Is Christianity a white man’s religion? Unspoken takes an in-depth look at the Christian heritage in Africa and examines how historical events have shaped today’s vastly popular perspective of Christianity. Take a two-part journey with scholars and influencers as they present an accurate account of this Asian, African, and Mid-Eastern established religion.

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with an undersea walk before heading to Port Louis to meet Lloyd in Chinatown. A massive archway welcomes him onto the busy Chinatown streets and Brent and Lloyd whet their appetites with some Chinese street food. The Chinese influence on Mauritian food has been huge and there have been more than a few fusion dishes to come out of their Chinatown. Brent and Lloyd head to a local Chinese restaurant to try a popular dish that is unique to Mauritius, a Bol Renverse, an "upside-down bowl". After a delicious lunch Lloyd has a treat planned for Brent. He takes him to the Kwan Tee Pagoda, the oldest Pagoda in Mauritius and believed to be the oldest in the Southern Hemisphere. After a magical day Brent head's back to his hotel inspired and ready to cook up a storm. The next day Brent goes in search of ingredients in a local Chinese supermarket and then heads to a peaceful garden to cook his mustard pork with a twist.

programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: The rocks that make up the treeless landscape of the Shetland Islands are some of the oldest rock formations in the world. Three seas flow together here, making the waters treacherous and unpredicatble, but the island's stunning wildlife remains largely untouched.

programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: The Isle of Man lies in the midst of the Irish Sea between Ireland and England. Officially, it belongs to the Queen, yet it has its own laws and its own currency. Its crest is the 'three legs' that symbolise its resilient people. The island holds a fascinating history of Viking settlement.

programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: Only 25 km from the French coast lies the Channel Island of Jersey. Town names like St. Helier are reminders of its Norman ancestry. It has one of the most the most extreme tidal ranges in the world, and we will meet the Lighthouse Warden, who lives in the lighthouse that has a history of keeping pirates and smugglers off the island.

programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: Turquoise seas, picturesque countryside, secluded coves: the Scilly Isles are Britain's sunny paradise. The mild climate allows beautiful exotic plants, even palm trees, to thrive on here. There are 140 islands, and their coves and beaches are popular with the Royals.

programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: In the north west of Scotland stretches the island chain of the Outer Hebrides. A barren and foresaken landscape, although there are no trees, its beauty is capitvating. Fertile marshland and rocky scapes make for a harsh but wild environment, which the Queen has come to love as a holiday spot.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger meets Mr. Pierogi and celebrates Pierogi Fest in Whiting, Indiana; ducks for cover at Lambert’s Café “Home of the Throwed Rolls” in Alabama; and cheers on the daring (and possibly deranged) participants at a Unicycle Football game in San Marcos, Texas.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The Marquisate was still able to maintain its core identity, and gave birth to a rich local culture; this spirit exists in the Rocca of Castellar; in the Castello of Manta, with the fresco cycle of the Nine Worthies in the Baronial Hall.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The Accona desert in the heart of the Tuscan countryside, with artwork along the Via Francigena including its multiple frescoes.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: Connecting Padua and Venice, the Brenta Riviera boasts many Venetian Villas built between the 15th and 18th Century after the discovery of America began to render local maritime trade less important.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: Founded when the people of Amalfi freed themselves from the reigning Lombards in the Principality of Benevento. We travel back in time to the election of their first local aristocratic dukes via a visit to the church of Saint Salvatore de Birecto. We learn more about the history of the region in the Chronicon Salernitanum and take a look at Raphael's painting 'The Battle of Ostia'.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The State of the Presidi is a swampy, malarial land, which, thanks only to human resilience and intelligence, became a centre of wealth and culture. The journey starts from the Metalliferous Hills of Maremma, rich in raw metals and the historical capital of mining territory, and continues to the historical buildings and the ancient water springs of Massa Maratima with its famous Fertility Tree.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The history of the Duchy of Urbino is really the history of two families: the Montefeltros and the Della Roveres, nobles and patrons who bid for everlasting fame with architectural and artistic works. Their efforts resulted in the painting The Flagellation of Christ, the rooms of the Ducal Palace, the Guest apartment with the King Of England's Room, the Throne Room and the Chapel of Guidubaldo.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: Situated between the Alps in France and the duchy of Savoy, and influenced by both regions, the Marquisate was still able to maintain its core identity, and gave birth to a rich local culture. This spirit exists in the Rocca of Castellar; in the Castello of Manta, with the fresco cycle of the Nine Worthies in the Baronial Hall or the painting of the Madonna del Latte in the church of Santa Maria.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: It took almost 400 years and the work of hundreds of highly qualified architects, engineers, plasterers, painters, and woodworkers who all contributed to the transformation of the Isola Bella. Up until 1630 the Isola Bella was only a rocky crag occupied by a few fishermen, two small churches and a few unassuming gardens. At the turn of the 17th century the House of Borromeo initiated change.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: According to mythology, Anagni was established by Saturn himself in an area surrounded by huge calcareous walls. Historically, we know that the town was conquered by the Roman Empire at the beginning of the IV century B.C. Even though it was influenced by the Holy See, during the Middle Age Anagni was a free town where two families, the Caetanis and the Colonnas, fought hard for supremacy.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: In 1693, an unprecedented earthquake hit the Valley of Noto destroying several small towns such as Modica, Ragusa and Scicli, which were all included in the Norman Kingdom of Sicili. More than 90,000 lives were lost. Giuseppe Lanza, the Spanish appointed viceroy, took charge of the reconstruction of the area. He called on Sicilian architects Giovanni Baptista, Vaccarini and Rosario Gagliardi.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The county of Soleto was founded in 1055: the Norman Robert Guiscard of Hauteville conquered the rusty lands of Southern Salento and entrusted Earl Orsini with them. Soleto can now boast the only remaining legacy of the region's Norman age: the 'Guglia di Raimondello' the striking bell tower which is considered one of the finest examples of Apulian gothic style.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The duchy of Castro was founded in 1537 by Pope Paul III, Alessandro Farnese, who wanted to donate the area to his son Pier Luigi. The dukedom includes not only Ischia di Castro, the capital city that was destroyed in 1649 by the Papal troops, but also Valentano and Capodimonte where you can still admire the amazing palaces of the Farnese family...

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Estaban Finita y Brigitte hablando | cuando llega Wilker y le comenta a Briggite sobre la grabación de sus canciones y el nombre del grupo donde canta y que la ROKUra canción que salga en la radio será dedicada a ella | en eso Cowalscky le dice a Wilker que vaya al estudio a ver que le hace falta y él invita a Brigitte y se despiden; en eso entra Yubiri pendiente que Briggite le va a preguntar por la tarea | pero al mismo tiempo pensando que Briggite | no la roba más.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: María Antonia y Paco discuten porque él se ha desentendido durante muchos años de Gerson y le pide que se ocupe de él, pero que no lo lleve a su casa. Yuraima se siente muy mal por haber corrido a Gerson de la casa, pero Gladis le ofrece su apoyo.

programme.title: Episodio 11
programme.desc: Celia descubre que Moisés es su hijo. Ricardo oculta a Manuela que no puede concebir, mientras Katiuska lo confronta por su doble vida. Gustavo escapa y vaga como indigente hasta llegar al estudio de Margot, quien suspende sus planes tras enterarse del estado de salud de Manuela. Elizabeth visita a Manuela, y Marcelo confiesa a su hijo René la infidelidad que causará su divorcio. Celia planea su venganza contra Manuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto entrega a Consuelo los documentos de propiedad del local intentando reconciliarse. Adolfo, manipulado por Esteban, acusa a Alejandro de traidor y conspirador. Rosa pide trabajo a Isaías tras pelearse con Natalia. Maricela sufre lagunas mentales por su alcoholismo. Natalia acepta el apartamento que le ofrece Erasto. Arminda y Eustoquio planifican la muerte de Consuelo, mientras Blanca permanece desaparecida tras el atropello. Rosa y Consuelo se reconcilian de equívocos en la boutique, sin sospechar el vínculo de sangre que las une.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucía al enterarse que no es hija de Trinidad, decide escapar de su casa, sin decirle a nadie donde se encuentra, lo que preocupa muchísimo a su familia. Pero Leo se encuentra con ella y la ayuda a encontrar un lugar seguro. Su familia intenta saber dónde está, para que vuelva lo antes posible. Alejandra se está por ir a Europa, pero quiere cancelar el viaje cuando le notifican que Virginia Gutiérrez es ahora una empleada de confianza en la empresa, cuando no pasó por su autorización ni exámenes de ingreso. Rodrigo no dejará que Alejandra ponga por encima de su relación su venganza. Trinidad le exige a Virginia la verdad completa, que le diga de una vez por todas el secreto de toda su vida, quién es el padre de María Lucía.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Heriberto han contraído matrimonio y continúan con sus planes para atrapar a Reina Monserrat. Sol contrata a Carmen como su nueva abogada y llama a Reina para darle la noticia y hacerle saber que está al tanto de Cristina, su hija abandonada. Al mismo tiempo Giselle y Cristo José también se casan pero deben suspender el brindis por un mensaje de Rika que los cita con urgencia con noticias sobre Giselle. Al llegar a la casa de Rika Carlucho los recibe con Giselle que se encuentra con vida.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucía sigue sin volver con su familia. Y, estando con Leo en una casa de campo, comienzan a pasar cosas entre ellos. A Trinidad le aterra esa relación, porque sospecha que María Lucía podría ser la hija de Miguel Ferrándiz. Virginia comienza a trabajar en la empresa. Pero las cosas se complican cuando se filtra en un correo electrónico el rumor de que Virginia mató a Miguel. Leonardo y Carlos Ernesto tratan de buscar al responsable. El capítulo finaliza cuando Trinidad, preocupada por la posibilidad de que su nieta sea pariente de Leo Ferrándiz, se acerca a la casa de Jimena para que puedan hablar del éste tema que les incumbe a ambas.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol consigue que Reina se doblegue ante ella. Reina está dispuesta a darle todo a cambio de que no siga buscando a su hija. Pero a Sol no le interesa todo el dinero que le ofrece Reina, sino Solamente verla sufrir y pagar por todo el daño que hizo. Más tarde, Eloy visita a Sol y juntos continúan elaborando el plan para sacarle todo el poder a Reina. Minutos después, la policía toca la puerta, ya que vienen a arrestar a Eloy por la posesión del arma usada en el crimen contra los Figueras.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri le dice a Briggite que quiere renunciar al trabajo y Briggite la invita a comer a un restaurante | con el fin de convencerla que no renuncie | porque ella la necesita para que le de ideas para las campañas publicitarias. En tanto Olegario y Ana conversan sobre lo sucedido entre ellos | aducen que fue un resbalón y hablan sobre Mauricio y Pastor | piensan que el comportamiento de ellos | es rarísimo. Mientras Pastor y la Secretaria están en la oficina hablando | él la invita a tomar café.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: El día en la oficina se vuelve incómodo cuando Luis Fernando le pide a Dileidy que la acompañe a ver un terreno y Aureliano se pone celoso. Después, Santiago se ofrece para llevar a Matilde al hotel donde está Moncho y Gonzalo supone que es traicionado.

programme.title: Episodio 12
programme.desc: Moisés y Elizabeth se ven a escondidas, mientras Misael busca recuperar a su hija. Manuela ignora que no puede ser madre y Ricardo mantiene la mentira sobre su salud. Katiuska revela a Hortensia la doble vida de Ricardo con Celia para desestabilizar la unión. Celia, instigada por Katiuska, intenta hacerle daño a Manuela en la clínica manipulando su medicamento, pero es sorprendida por Ricardo en el acto. La tensión crece mientras las verdades y traiciones comienzan a salir a la luz.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Eustoquio incendia la boutique siguiendo órdenes de Arminda contra Consuelo, atrapando a Rosa adentro. Rosa es rescatada inconsciente por los bomberos. Natalia, en plena disputa con Rosalía, revela que Alejandro es el novio de Rosa. Rosalía se siente humillada al saberse cambiada por una sirvienta. José Luis investiga la muerte de Carlos y descubre que Erasto fue el asesino del hermano de Rosa. Adolfo decide internar a Maricela en una clínica de desintoxicación. En el hospital, Blanca es atendida como desconocida sin familia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucía sigue sin volver con su familia. Y, estando con Leo en una casa de campo, comienzan a pasar cosas entre ellos. A Trinidad le aterra esa relación, porque sospecha que María Lucía podría ser la hija de Miguel Ferrándiz. Virginia comienza a trabajar en la empresa. Pero las cosas se complican cuando se filtra en un correo electrónico el rumor de que Virginia mató a Miguel. Leonardo y Carlos Ernesto tratan de buscar al responsable. El capítulo finaliza cuando Trinidad, preocupada por la posibilidad de que su nieta sea pariente de Leo Ferrándiz, se acerca a la casa de Jimena para que puedan hablar del éste tema que les incumbe a ambas.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol consigue que Reina se doblegue ante ella. Reina está dispuesta a darle todo a cambio de que no siga buscando a su hija. Pero a Sol no le interesa todo el dinero que le ofrece Reina, sino Solamente verla sufrir y pagar por todo el daño que hizo. Más tarde, Eloy visita a Sol y juntos continúan elaborando el plan para sacarle todo el poder a Reina. Minutos después, la policía toca la puerta, ya que vienen a arrestar a Eloy por la posesión del arma usada en el crimen contra los Figueras.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Trinidad le cuenta a Jimena que Miguel es el padre de María Lucía. Jimena, a su vez, va a hablar con Carlos, que le revela un secreto sobre Miguel que empeora aún más la situación. Irene cree que está embarazada y va a la casa de Zulay a hacerse un test. Agustina amenaza con echar a todo el personal de la casa si nadie admite haber destruido el cuadro de su hermana. Leonardo descubre quién envió el mail sobre Virginia. Rodrigo manda a Alejandra a Madrid para que tenga una reunión muy importante con Adolfo. Allí, Alejandra descubre un gran secreto y se ve involucrada en un extraño plan.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Eloy es detenido por la policía. Una vez en la comisaría, el comisario Zulbaga le explica que las pruebas para su detención fueron que alguien declaró ser cómplice de él al haber puesto el arma en su auto. Ese alguien fue Domingo, quien contratado por Reina, colocó el arma en el coche de Eloy, y al encontrar sus huellas digitales, la policía también lo detuvo. Sol logra contactarse con un hombre que trabajó en un quiosco frente a donde Reina abandonó a su bebé.

programme.title: Fuera del Menu
programme.desc: Una chef luchadora conocida por la mejor comida auténtica de todo el suroeste se enamora del improbable heredero de una franquicia de comida rápida mexicana.

programme.title: Solo Por Una Noche
programme.desc: El esposo de una mujer casada con una vida perfecta engaña a su hermana, con consecuencias extremas.

programme.title: Platillo Estatal
programme.desc: Illinois sorprende a Taylor, palomitas de maíz, sándwiches de carne, pizza de masa alta, perros calientes y un original sundae helado.

programme.title: Platillo Estatal
programme.desc: Taylor descubre en Wisconsin el requesón crujiente, las salchichas bratwurst, el chucrut, el pollo buuyah y los kringles con sabor frutal.

programme.title: Fuera del Menu
programme.desc: Una chef luchadora conocida por la mejor comida auténtica de todo el suroeste se enamora del improbable heredero de una franquicia de comida rápida mexicana.

programme.title: Espionaje en Londres
programme.desc: Durante una ola de asesinatos de agentes indios en Londres, dos agentes especiales se infiltraron en la embajada india en una carrera contrarreloj para identificar a un agente enemigo y evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: Kill Kane
programme.desc: Un hombre busca venganza cuando su esposa e hijos son asesinados a manos de una pandilla despiadada. Dado por muerto y sin nadie a quien recurrir, sale a la calle en busca de justicia y toma el asunto en sus propias manos.

programme.title: Deber Mortal
programme.desc: Obligado a retirarse del servicio militar tras una tragedia, Paul Lacey debe aceptar la muerte de sus hombres. Adormecido por la medicación para el trastorno de estrés postraumático, se ha desconectado y su vida ahora es una serie de rutinas mundanas. Su preocupada esposa, Sarah, lo convence para que la acompañe de vacaciones en un campamento, con la esperanza de que la ruptura ayude a reparar su tensa relación. La pareja llega a un lugar apartado, a kilómetros de la civilización. Sin embargo, su paz pronto se hace añicos cuando son testigos de un brutal asesinato cometido por una banda salvaje de europeos del este. Se les ve huyendo y, cuando cae la noche, buscan refugio en las profundidades de un gran bosque. A medida que la pandilla se acerca a la pareja, los instintos militares de Paul emergen rápidamente y deja atrás a Sarah para embarcarse en un escalofriante viaje de redención.

programme.title: Espionaje en Londres
programme.desc: Durante una ola de asesinatos de agentes indios en Londres, dos agentes especiales se infiltraron en la embajada india en una carrera contrarreloj para identificar a un agente enemigo y evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto sigue hospitalizado. Leo y su padre se reconcilian. Llega Julio y hay una evidente tensión entre los hermanos. Virginia le confiesa a Felipe el contenido de las cartas de Miguel Ferrándiz: habría un hijo de Rebeca que no es hijo de Leonardo. Oriana recibe el sobre del test de embarazo de manos de Alejandra y Maribel le cuenta a Irene que la licenciada está ayudando a la chica.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo y su hijo aclaran la cuestión del origen del rumor sobre su relación con Alejandra. Mientras tanto, Adolfo busca desesperadamente su tablet, primero exigiéndole respuestas a Tony y luego aventurándose a la mansión Ferrándiz para interrogar a Agustina. Martín, el asistente de Felipe se compromete con Rodrigo a conseguirle los documentos secretos de Miguel Ferrándiz.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo sigue encerrado con Irene en el ascensor y continúa con su macabro juego de insinuaciones y sugerencias para desestabilizarla. Toda la familia busca desesperadamente a Irene. Leonardo la llama sin cesar y no logra comunicarse. Lo propio ocurre con sus hermanas y su madre. Agustina le sugiere a Trinidad que Irene se fue en una aventura amorosa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo le reprocha a Irene que no le contó que se había quedado encerrada en el ascensor con el licenciado Basáñez y esta le dice que no le dijo porque no quería que tuviera más problemas y que fue una experiencia muy desagradable. Basáñez le llevas un presenta a Irene por lo del ascensor y esta trata de no aceptárselo pero al final lo acepta con la condición de que este no le moleste más.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Adolfo se disculpa públicamente por haber intentado derribar la gestión de Leonardo y admite que cometió un error pero luego le dice a Leonardo que quiere que le firme el documento que dice que lo apoya a cambio de que siga manteniendo voz y voto en las reuniones de junta directiva. Leonardo lo acepta. Virginia y Felipe van a la casa del doctor que firmó uno de los documentos de paternidad.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Adolfo dice que por asuntos que tiene que atender en el exterior no puede ocupar su cargo en la empresa pero deja a Rodrigo y cuando Leonardo se entera se enfurece. Rodrigo llega a la empresa y discute con Leonardo. Luego Alejandra le muestra su oficina y Rodrigo la comienza a besar sin darse cuentas que Leo los ve por el monitor de seguridad. María Lucía descubre a Leo besando a Maribel.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leo ve a Alejandra y Rodrigo juntos y luego le dice a Leonardo que sospecha de ella y también le pregunta cómo es que Leonardo permitió que Rodrigo trabajara en la empresa y este le explica que todo fue una jugada sucia de Adolfo Casares. Irene y Maribel tiene en su poder el CD donde están grabados Rodrigo y Alejandra por las cámaras de seguridad.

programme.title: Platillo Estatal
programme.desc: Taylor llega al mar en Maine, un plato de almejas de concha blanda al vapor, frijoles, papas, rollitos de langosta y pastel de arándanos.

programme.title: Punto de extremeño
programme.desc: Los experimentos gubernamentales ultrasecretos sobre viajes en el tiempo se suspenden y se declaran peligrosos

programme.title: La Señal de Dios
programme.desc: Después de perseguir a un grupo misterioso, el detective Tom Caboro sufre un terrible accidente y está en coma durante años. Cuando se despierta, el mundo ha cambiado y ve la marca del mal por todos lados. ¿Estaba esto relacionado con su investigación del pasado?

programme.desc: Cuando tres campistas son testigos de una nave nodriza alienígena que desciende sobre su ciudad y convierte a la población en seres humanos "alterados", se unen a un extraño solitario que se ofrece a guiarlos hacia un lugar seguro.

programme.title: Código Eterno
programme.desc: Cuando una directora ejecutiva se niega a aprobar un dispositivo ilegal que sustenta la vida humana, ella y su marido son secuestrados. Su hija debe desarrollar un aliado improbable para salvarlos de aquellos que matarían para vivir para siempre.

programme.title: Origins of the Universe: The Great Debate
programme.desc: El mundo que nos rodea contiene muchos sistemas complejos que funcionan perfectamente juntos. Durante muchos años ha habido un acalorado debate entre evolución y creación, con la pregunta central de todo: "¿Fue creada la Tierra o llegó a existir por sí sola?" Conozca a siete expertos en sus campos que han dedicado su vida al estudio de esta cuestión.

programme.title: Linea del Condado: Todo o Nada
programme.desc: El asesinato de un dudoso abogado en la línea condal, obliga a dos sheriffs a dejar sus diferencias de lado para atrapar al asesino.

programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: El tranquilo deber del sheriff Justin Wise sirve para proteger el pueblo de Blue Ridge mientras cria a su hija adolescente, pero todo se destruye cuando la comisaría es consumida por el fuego en circunstancias misteriosas y mortales.

programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: Unos buscadores de emociones montan un atraco al estilo western en una vieja carretera rural, lo que atrae la atención de Justin y su equipo, y también la venganza de su víctima: un legendario jinete de toros con fama de violento.

programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: El promotor turbio de una liga local de lucha libre es encontrado muerto bajo el ring de la escuela secundaria de Blue Ridge. Al investigar su pasado, Justin y su equipo descubren que casi todo el que lo conocía tenía motivos para matarlo.

programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: Un raro día libre de Justin se arruina cuando el autobús de gira de una banda country problematica se descompone. Él debe lidiar con el interés romántico de una bella violinista y el caos que causa su guardaespaldas abusivo por todo el pueblo.

programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: Una querida entrenadora de caballos es asesinada a punto de retirarse. Cuando el equipo de Justin descubre su testamento, ven que incluye un cambio de última hora que podría ser la razón de su muerte… y la clave para resolver el asesinato.

programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: El mundo de Justin se sacude cuando su exesposa y su hija son tomadas como rehenes por un veterano de guerra enfurecido en la comisaría de Blue Ridge. Desesperado por mantener a su familia a salvo, Justin entrega su arma y se encierra junto a los rehenes.

programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: El tranquilo deber del sheriff Justin Wise sirve para proteger el pueblo de Blue Ridge mientras cria a su hija adolescente, pero todo se destruye cuando la comisaría es consumida por el fuego en circunstancias misteriosas y mortales.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Guiada por el idealismo y la tradición familiar, Laura se une a un escuadrón de policías antidisturbios, en sus primeras salidas ya nota su gusto por la adrenalina, pero un gran error destapa el ambiente de corrupción de la institución, poniendo en riesgo sus servicios y sus ideales.

programme.title: Accion Legal
programme.desc: Un abogado descubre la gran corrupción del pequeño pueblo en el jucio a su ex cuñado, acusado de asesinar a un fiscal del distrito local.

programme.title: Linea del Condado
programme.desc: Cuando su amigo es aesinado, el ex sherif se enfrenta a una red delictiva mientras investiga el asesinato que parece ser parte de la red.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror 26/11 – La Serie
programme.desc: Ismail es abatido, Kasab captura al jefe de la ATS en un enfrentamiento, y los comandos navales llegan al lugar. Parvati logra entrevistar a Andreas en directo. Finalmente, la NSG toma el control de la situación.

programme.desc: Experience an array of special grill courses with Tepanyaki cooking each a sizzling delight.

programme.title: FoodieBoy

programme.desc: Renzo y Amado se declaran la guerra. El líder de los Balcanes da la orden a Ojeda de traerle a Diana Ahumada para dar el próximo golpe a su enemigo. Pío intenta escapar de las autoridades.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.desc: Pío José quiere recuperar los 300 kilos de cocaína que Diana le robó; para lograrlo, manda a secuestrar a su mamá y hermana. Pero es él quien se lleva la sorpresa de su vida.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Nos adentramos en el mundo de la Lucha Libre Mexicana junto a Tinieblas y Tinieblas Jr. Una dinastía que ha llevado el espectáculo, la fuerza y la tradición de este deporte a lo más alto. Entre anécdotas de entrenamientos, giras internacionales y combates memorables, padre e hijo comparten cómo se vive la lucha desde dentro y lo que significa portar una máscara que es símbolo y herencia. Hablamos de la disciplina detrás del cuadrilátero, de la conexión con el público, de la evolución de la lucha libre a lo largo de los años y del compromiso de mantener vivo un legado familiar. Un episodio lleno de historia, orgullo y la energía única que solo se siente cuando suena la campana.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Ricardo Olavarrieta, expatinador artístico y pionero del deporte en México, quien nos comparte su trayectoria desde que descubrió su pasión por el patinaje a los seis años hasta representar a México en los Juegos Olímpicos de Invierno de Calgary 1988 y Albertville 1992. Además, comparte sus experiencias como competidor y especialista técnico, la creación de la Federación Mexicana de Patinaje y su participación en la formación de nuevas generaciones de atletas. Entre recuerdos de sus competencias, la emoción de estar en los Juegos Olímpicos y la evolución del patinaje artístico en Latinoamérica, Ricardo Olavarrieta nos ofrece una mirada inspiradora sobre la pasión, la constancia y la dedicación necesarias para sobresalir en un deporte de alto rendimiento.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conocemos el lado más humano y deportivo de Melvin Brown, exfutbolista profesional mexicano. A través de una conversación íntima y dinámica, el programa recorre su trayectoria desde sus inicios en Cruz Azul Hidalgo, donde el deporte formó parte esencial de su infancia, hasta su consolidación como figura clave en equipos como Cruz Azul y Jaguares, de Chiapas. Melvin comparte momentos decisivos de su carrera como su llegada a las fuerzas básicas del Cruz Azul a los 17 años, su debut en primera división, su experiencia en la Copa Libertadores del 2001, y cómo enfrentó lesiones, presiones y decisiones técnicas que marcaron su rumbo, como no jugar en el Mundial.

programme.title: Viva la tarde

programme.title: Los datos son los datos

programme.title: Destinos Cruzados
programme.desc: Las vidas de varias personas muy diversas de California del Sur se interceptan y algunas veces se encienden en esta serie adaptada a la televisión de la película que ganó el Premio Oscar a Mejor Película en el 2005. Los caracteres actuales incluyen a un productor musical autodestructivo y envejecido, Ben Cendars; Antonhy Adams, el conductor ingenioso de Ben; Christine Emory, la esposa con dinero y madre que se encuentra en una crisis de la edad madura; Kenny Battaglia, un policía adorable pero presuntuoso; el inmigrante coreano, Eddie Choi, que trabaja como paramédico estudiando para ser doctor; Bebe Arcel, una policía que era actriz; Cesar Ulman un inmigrante guatemalteco pobre pero optimista; Axel Finet, un teniente de la policía creído e Inez, una esposa sexy del líder de los gitanos.

programme.title: La Bella Durmiente de Al Lado
programme.desc: La extraña condición de Sydney la hace desplomarse cada vez que las emociones se intensifican, especialmente cuando se trata del amor. Cuando su encantador nuevo vecino, Taylor, le roba el corazón, ella debe luchar por mantenerse despierta el tiempo suficiente para convertir su romance soñado en realidad.

programme.title: El Amor En Su Mejor Versión
programme.desc: Rebecca, una "mejoradora" de imagen de increíble éxito que se especializa en sacar a relucir la mejor versión de uno mismo, se enfrenta a su reto más formidable hasta la fecha en el encantador pero muy estancado en sus costumbres, Clive, una antigua estrella del fútbol.

programme.title: Un Extraño en la Boda de Mi Hermano
programme.desc: April Monroe es una doctora superestrella en un gran hospital de Nueva York, que se ha enamorado perdidamente del encantador veterinario Jesse, y su relación parece ir por buen camino excepto por una cosa: Jesse es completamente hermético sobre su familia Amish.

programme.title: Desacuerdo Romántico

programme.title: Historias de Amor en Sunflower Valley
programme.desc: Kate trabaja en un periódico de Seattle y su nuevo destino la lleva a su pueblo natal, Sunflower Valley. Su apuesto compañero de trabajo llega con ella y desentrañan una serie de enternecedoras historias de amor sobre la gente del pueblo.

programme.title: Amor a La Pizza
programme.desc: En Evanstown, un suburbio de Chicago, los Romano y los Juliato, dos familias rivales dedicadas a la pizza, han estado enfrentadas durante años. Pero cuando sus hijos se enamoran, este romance prohibido amenaza con sacar a la luz secretos guardados por mucho tiempo y cambiar para siempre el destino de ambas familias.

programme.desc: Claire es una enfermera con un supervisor que intenta hacerla sentir miserable. En una noche libre, queda atrapada en un ascensor con un hombre encantador. Al salir se dan cuenta de que ninguno de los dos ha dicho su nombre y temen no volver a encontrarse nunca.
